value: FLSA-exempt employees at least monthly; all others at least twice a month
summary: Texas pay frequency rule: FLSA-exempt employees at least monthly; all others at least twice a month.
evidence_quote: Sec. 61.011. (a) An employer shall pay wages to each employee who is exempt from the overtime pay provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 ... at least once a month. (b) An employer shall pay wages to an employee other than an employee covered by Subsection (a) at least twice a month.

value: Salaried employees at least monthly; hourly employees at least every two weeks or twice a month
summary: Virginia pay frequency rule: Salaried employees at least monthly; hourly employees at least every two weeks or twice a month.
evidence_quote: All such employers shall pay salaried employees at least once each month and employees paid on an hourly rate at least once every two weeks or twice in each month
notes: Exceptions for work-study students and employees above 150% of the state average weekly wage who agree to monthly pay.

value: Semi-monthly schedule: first-half wages by the 1st of the next month, second-half wages by the 15th
summary: Ohio pay frequency rule: Semi-monthly schedule: first-half wages by the 1st of the next month, second-half wages by the 15th.
evidence_quote: (A) Every employer doing business in this state shall, on or before the first day of each month, pay all its employees the wages earned by them during the first half of the preceding month ending with the fifteenth day thereof, and shall, on or before the fifteenth day of each month, pay such employees the wages earned by them during the last half of the preceding calendar month.
notes: Section also says it does not prohibit daily or weekly payment.

value: Regular paydays designated in advance; wages due within 15 days after the pay period ends unless a contract or trade custom sets otherwise
summary: Pennsylvania pay frequency rule: Regular paydays designated in advance; wages due within 15 days after the pay period ends unless a contract or trade custom sets otherwise.
evidence_quote: All wages, other than fringe benefits and wage supplements, earned in any pay period shall be due and payable within the number of days after the expiration of said pay period as provided in a written contract of employment or, if not so specified, within the standard time lapse customary in the trade or within 15 days from the end of such pay period.
source_title: Wage Payment and Collection Law, Section 3 (PA DLI copy)
source_publisher: Pennsylvania Department of Labor and Industry

value: Most wages at least twice per calendar month on designated regular paydays
summary: California pay frequency rule: Most wages at least twice per calendar month on designated regular paydays.
evidence_quote: In California, wages, with some exceptions (see table below), must be paid at least twice during each calendar month on the days designated in advance as regular paydays.
source_title: Paydays, pay periods, and the final wages (California DIR)
source_publisher: California Department of Industrial Relations, Division of Labor Standards Enforcement

value: Manual workers weekly (within 7 days of week end); clerical and other workers at least semi-monthly
summary: New York pay frequency rule: Manual workers weekly (within 7 days of week end); clerical and other workers at least semi-monthly.
evidence_quote: Manual Workers: Wages must be paid weekly and not later than seven calendar days after the end of the week in which the wages are earned. ... Clerical or Other Workers: Wages must be paid in accordance with the agreed terms of employment and not less frequently than semi-monthly.
source_title: Frequency of Pay Frequently Asked Questions (NYS DOL)
source_publisher: New York State Department of Labor

value: At least once per month; employers with 5 or more employees must keep regular paydays
summary: Tennessee pay frequency rule: At least once per month; employers with 5 or more employees must keep regular paydays.
evidence_quote: Private employers with 5 or more employees are required to establish and maintain regular pay days. Employees are required to be paid at least once per month.
source_publisher: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development

value: At least semimonthly, or biweekly if requested
summary: Indiana pay frequency rule: At least semimonthly, or biweekly if requested.
evidence_quote: shall pay each employee at least semimonthly or biweekly, if requested, the amount due the employee.
notes: Wages must be paid to a date not more than 10 business days before payment (same section).
